title: Innovative and fun app but…
body:
Great intuitive habits apps.

Have to give you 5 stars for making it fun.

I even upgraded to premium

It made my kids fall in love with the habit tracker.

They love the 60 day challenge when different things are building up. 

The reason for 4 stars is: 

It Lacks the few important useful options which i request you to kindly add. 

1. No option to track habits that we do multiple times in a day. 
2. No icloud Sync option
3. We have to manually calculate how many times we did the habit in a month, no statistics. 

Overall a very unique and  delightful app to use. 

Please add those additional options as requested.

title: A lovely app
body:
I have never been excited about habit building apps and their bloody trackers. I’ve always forgotten about them, or lost enthusiasm or hated the layout. 

This app, however, is different. I am currently suffering from anxiety and trying to meditate everyday. I’ve found myself doing the habit just to see what I find next inside this app. 

The monuments that are built when you mark a day as done are delightful. And the sound design is too good. 

The only habit app I’ll be using.
